role: Civil Design Engineer (Cadet or Graduate level)
subject: Civil Design Engineer, Graduate level (Wagga Wagga): Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello Engineering Design Services team,

I am applying for the Senior Design Engineer Civil (all experience levels) position at Graduate level, listed on Council's Pulse jobs board and closing 1 November.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. Before that I worked on site in the Philippines from 2019 to 2020 as a project in charge engineer and then a field engineer. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

The advert says the Cadet or Graduate engineer will help senior staff deliver road, stormwater and sewer designs for tender and construction, and names Civil 3D and AutoCAD. Road and stormwater design are the core of my diploma work; I have not designed sewer networks and have not used 12d Model yet, and my design work so far is from study rather than a paid role.

Could we arrange a time to talk about the Graduate level? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

letter.subject: Application for Senior Design Engineer Civil (all experience levels), Graduate level
paragraphs: I am applying for the Senior Design Engineer Civil (all experience levels) position in Engineering Design Services, at the Cadet or Graduate level. At that level the role assists senior staff to deliver road, stormwater and sewer designs suitable for tender and construction, which is the work I trained for.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. The course covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage, with drawings prepared and reviewed in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi (2014 to 2019). In the diploma I lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services and site constraints.

From April to September 2019 I was project in charge engineer on a community hall renovation in the Philippines, coordinating 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewing drawings and carrying out site inspections and quality checks. From September 2019 to February 2020 I was a field engineer on subdivision finishing works, preparing site reports, material records and progress reports and working with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

I have not designed sewer networks, and I have not used 12d Model, DRAINS or GIS software on a job. My AutoCAD and Civil 3D experience is from study rather than a commercial design office, so I would expect to learn Council's design standards and processes under supervision.

I am based in Melton VIC, hold a driver licence, a White Card and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Wagga Wagga for this role. My resume is attached and study drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

screening_answers.question: Level applied for
screening_answers.answer: Cadet or Graduate level (not Experienced or Senior; no CPEng or NER registration).

screening_answers.answer: Yes, willing to undergo applicable pre-employment checks.
